subject: Evidence request: employee screening, training, and offboarding artifacts (SOC 2)
messages:
From: Jamie Lee <j.lee@ventishealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditOps <auditops@ventishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: employee screening, training, and offboarding artifacts (SOC 2)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — Ventis Health is doing our annual SOC 2 readiness review and we are collecting HR control evidence for CC6 (HR & personnel). For Redwood we need the following artifacts as part of the HR sample:

- Training attendance logs (last 12 months) — CSV or spreadsheet accepted
- A sample of background check records (20 employees) with PII redacted as needed
- Current background check policy and effective date
- Standard offboarding checklist used when an employee leaves
- DocuSign manifest or proof of signature collection for new-hire agreements (redacted)

Can you confirm whether redacted background checks are acceptable and if you can provide the files by end of day Monday (2026-06-15)? If any of these items require an NDA/data transfer step, let me know.

Appreciate it — if it helps route a pack internally we can accept a Drive link and a short index.

Regards,
Jamie Lee
Senior IT Auditor, Ventis Health
Attachment: request-template.pdf (stub)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lee <j.lee@ventishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: employee screening, training, and offboarding artifacts (SOC 2)

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we assemble the pack:

1) Background checks: redacted PII is fine — we usually provide candidate ID, hire date, verification type, and redacted SSNs. Confirm that format works for Ventis audit team.
2) DocuSign manifest: we can provide a redacted manifest showing envelope IDs, signers, and timestamps; full signer email addresses will be redacted.
3) Preferred transfer method: we will share a Drive folder and a short index PDF. If you need a signed DPA for data transfer, please flag.

CCing Naomi (HR) to pull the background-check sample and Laura (People Ops) for training logs and offboarding checklist. Marcus, Karthik — looping you as FYI for any security-specific notes on remote hires.

Targeting an initial bundle by Mon 15 Jun EOD PST. If anything needs to be earlier, tell me.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: compile training & BGC artifacts for Ventis audit (due 2026-06-15)

Team,

Ventis Health requested several HR artifacts for their SOC 2 review. Please see required items and owners below:

- Training attendance (12 months) — owner: Laura. Deliver as CSV with employee ID, role, course name, date completed. (placeholder file name: employee_training_attendance_2025-06_to_2026-05.csv)
- Background check sample (20 employees) — owner: Naomi. Provide redacted CSV + brief explanation of vendor and checks performed. (bgc_batch_report_2026-05.csv)
- Background check policy (current) — owner: Karthik. Attach PDF with version and effective date. (background_check_policy_v2_2025-11.pdf)
- Offboarding checklist — owner: Laura. Provide standard checklist used by People Ops. (offboarding_checklist_standard.xlsx)
- DocuSign manifest (redacted) — owner: Olga/Legal. I will produce a redacted manifest after we assemble the other items.

Please upload artifacts to: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/HR/SOC2/Training/Attendance and drop a one-line index comment in JIRA SEC-4521. If you hit any legal/PII concerns, escalate to me immediately.

Thanks — aiming to send the external bundle by 2026-06-15 17:00 PST.

Olga

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACTION: compile training & BGC artifacts for Ventis audit (due 2026-06-15)

Hi — attaching the training attendance export and the offboarding checklist (see attachments). Notes:

- employee_training_attendance_2025-06_to_2026-05.csv (attachment stub) — includes completed_by, employee_id (internal), course, completion_date, course_version. We removed manager comments per HR request.
- offboarding_checklist_standard.xlsx (attachment stub) — includes steps for IT deprovision, asset return, access removal; used since 2024-10.

I uploaded both to the Drive folder and added an index to SEC-4521. Naomi: let me know if you want any additional columns in the training export.

Thanks,
Laura
People Ops
Attachment: employee_training_attendance_2025-06_to_2026-05.csv (CSV stub)
Attachment: offboarding_checklist_standard.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Jamie Lee <j.lee@ventishealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditOps <auditops@ventishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: employee screening, training, and offboarding artifacts (SOC 2)

Thanks Olga and team — we received the Drive index and the training attendance file. Two follow-ups before we close the sample:

1) Could you provide a redacted sample background-check record that includes the verification method and timestamp (for one remote hire)? We need to see the identity verification flow for remote onboarding.
2) Please include a redacted DocuSign envelope manifest (just envelope IDs, signer role, and timestamps) for the same new-hire batch.

If you can get those two items by EOD today (2026-06-15) that would be great — they are the last pieces.

Best,
Jamie
